reviews.review:
Hey, what do you know? I get to leave the first review for a game.

I loved this game. It's so unique I don't even think you could categorize it. The concept of scouring a fake OS for any hints on how to unlock the secret file, not in the style of solving a mystery, but almost in the style of hunting for random easter eggs that don't really play into a larger plot is an experience like I've never quite had before. It might sound too simple, but it derives difficulty in making you think to check everything and remember what you've already checked to avoid going in circles. The zany atmosphere of said OS also helps assure this never gets boring.

Based on the achievements page, it looks as though I'm the second person to beat this game, and I assume the other is one of the devs, so I'm the first person to beat this game since devs don't count. This is just the experience I came to the depths of Steam for: To discover and beat a fun game no one or very very very few had before, and this granted my wish in just about the best way possible.

Thank you for making this. I'll try for a 100% completion as well.
